name: gallery.net
description: A gallery site for your networking install photos, grouped by phase, hosted on GitHub Pages. The interface follows the Samsung Gallery app (One UI, dark): a **Pictures** tab with every photo on a day-grouped wall, an **Albums** tab with one cover per phase, a bottom tab bar, and a fullscreen swipe viewer. Desktop defaults to a landscape layout (wide column, denser wall); phones and tablets follow the device orientation — portrait keeps the phone-width column, landscape widens to match.
